decisions.reason: As a flagship launch shown on the home page and tightly aligned with the firm’s cloud messaging direction, it remains a strong option worth keeping while market learning continues.
Its own page signals meaningful commitment and it fits the firm’s document workflow expansion, so management would likely keep it to gather more evidence on uptake.
Although only lightly promoted, it builds on the installed email and fax base and is likely inexpensive to keep on offer while demand uncertainty resolves.
As a close-to-core optimization feature, it probably has low carrying cost and supports existing fax-heavy customer processes, making continued availability the more option-preserving choice.
Threat protection directly reinforces the firm’s secure communications value proposition, so it is sensible to retain while customer adoption and cross-sell potential become clearer.
Multi-engine virus scanning complements the secure messaging stack and should be relatively cheap to maintain, so the firm would likely keep this option open despite limited prominence.
